items.title: Generalized Hamiltonian deformations of imploded doubles and flat-connection moduli from multiplicative to additive geometry
items.author: Mohamed Moussadek Maiza
items.difficulty_reason: The independent singular multiplicative-to-additive construction requires a generalized Hamiltonian deformation framework for stratified imploded spaces, continuity and quotient-topology control across alcove/Weyl-chamber faces, stratum-by-stratum deformation, fusion compatibility and a reduction theorem with original transversality/stabilizer hypotheses. The full Theorem1.6 (all three conclusions together) and its sections2-6 proofs are retained. This is separate from the sections7-8 TQFT construction, not an extra count for its support corollaries.

primary.label: complete original independent Theorem 1.6 with all three imploded-double/surface/reduction conclusions

proof_spans.label: complete author smooth/fusion deformation theory, generalized stratified definition, reduction theorem, imploded-double construction and surface moduli deformation proofs

contexts.label: original compact Lie, multiplicative/additive and imploded-cross-section definitions
original comparison to separate quiver/TQFT construction and notation
